issues.description: Inconsistent identifier for the static method that computes a Meal's total price: the problem statement / UML require a static method named calculateTotalPrice(Meal): int (see UML line and the note that calculateTotalPrice must be static), but the solution implements this functionality as a static method named computeMealCost(Meal) in SealSaloon, and the provided template and example callers are inconsistent (template Main calls computeMealCost, while the commented example in solution Main calls calculateTotalPrice). This naming divergence across problem statement, template, and solution will confuse students about which method name and signature to implement and which name the tests/examples expect.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a single canonical method name and update all artifacts to match. Preferably rename the method in SealSaloon to match the UML: public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal) and update all example calls in both template and solution Main to call calculateTotalPrice(...). Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to use computeMealCost and make the UML, examples, template, and solution consistent. Ensure the method signature (static, parameter type Meal, return int) matches the UML/tests.
